claims.assertion: Anéeka says Karistus claim Earth as their former home and regard humanlike spacefarers as Karistus.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She attributes this to Karistus belief.

claims.assertion: She says the Federation limits human solar expansion to protect other technological races, including Karistus.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Karistus oppose its permissiveness toward Earth.

claims.assertion: She says the Federation negotiates with humanity’s controllers, not directly with humans or politicians.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She also says humans ultimately create their governments.
